searchText: I've been getting this error when running `kurtosis` & `ethereum-package` locally. Is anyone else having the same issue? or is there something I need to update on my end? looks like there's a mismatch in config name: ``` Adding service with name 'dora' and image 'ethpandaops/dora:latest' There was an error executing Starlark code An error occurred executing instruction (number 53) at github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/src/dora/dora_launcher.star[100:21]: add_service(name="dora", config=ServiceConfig(image="ethpandaops/dora:latest", ports={"http": PortSpec(number=8080, transport_protocol="TCP", application_protocol="http")}, public_ports={}, files={"/config": "dora-config", "/validator-ranges": "validator-ranges"}, cmd=["-config", "/config/dora-config.yaml"], env_vars={}, max_cpu=1000, min_cpu=100, max_memory=2048, min_memory=128, node_selectors={})) Caused by: Unexpected error occurred starting service 'dora' Caused by: An error occurred waiting for all TCP and UDP ports to be open for service 'dora' with private IP '172.16.0.19'; this is usually due to a misconfiguration in the service itself, so here are the logs: == SERVICE 'dora' LOGS =================================== time="2024-08-28T00:30:15Z" level=fatal msg="error reading config file: tried to set known chain-config, but unknown chain-name" == FINISHED SERVICE 'dora' LOGS =================================== Caused by: An error occurred while waiting for all TCP and UDP ports to be open Caused by: Unsuccessful ports check for IP '172.16.0.19' and port spec '{privatePortSpec:0xc000ab6840}', even after '240' retries with '500' milliseconds in between retries. Timeout '2m0s' has been reached Caused by: An error occurred while calling network address '172.16.0.19:8080' with port protocol 'TCP' and using time out '200ms' Caused by: dial tcp 172.16.0.19:8080: i/o timeout Error encountered running Starlark code. ``` oh it works fine if I use the 4.2.0 tag. Seems to be related to the change in this PR: https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/748 Do you usually work off of pinned releases? nah i usually just use the latest without any commit / tag 😅 Is this a known issue? I can raise an issue on the repo if it's not already fixed not yet, we'll look into it in a bit and get back to you! so using ethpandaops/ethereum-package breaks and leads to the error and using v4.2.0 works? if so could you send us the kurtosis config you used? are you running with latest dora image? can you run with `--image-download always` most likely you have an older dora:latest image cached locally yea, it pretty much sounds like an old image, because all that chain config stuff, incl. the error message you posted is no longer there in the latest release Ah right, that makes sense . Maybe it’s just an old image! I’ll test it out tomorrow Is it worth pinning the image versions in the package too? I think that would be a pain We recommend ppl to just not use local images and always run with --image-download always it adds about 3/4 sec extra each time to check if you are on latest

I've been getting this error when running `kurtosis` & `ethereum-package` locally. Is anyone else having the same issue? or is there something I need to update on my end? looks like there's a mismatch in config name:

```
Adding service with name 'dora' and image 'ethpandaops/dora:latest'
There was an error executing Starlark code
An error occurred executing instruction (number 53) at github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/src/dora/dora_launcher.star[100:21]:
  add_service(name="dora", config=ServiceConfig(image="ethpandaops/dora:latest", ports={"http": PortSpec(number=8080, transport_protocol="TCP", application_protocol="http")}, public_ports={}, files={"/config": "dora-config", "/validator-ranges": "validator-ranges"}, cmd=["-config", "/config/dora-config.yaml"], env_vars={}, max_cpu=1000, min_cpu=100, max_memory=2048, min_memory=128, node_selectors={}))
  Caused by: Unexpected error occurred starting service 'dora'
  Caused by: An error occurred waiting for all TCP and UDP ports to be open for service 'dora' with private IP '172.16.0.19'; this is usually due to a misconfiguration in the service itself, so here are the logs:
  == SERVICE 'dora' LOGS ===================================
  time="2024-08-28T00:30:15Z" level=fatal msg="error reading config file: tried to set known chain-config, but unknown chain-name"

  == FINISHED SERVICE 'dora' LOGS ===================================
  Caused by: An error occurred while waiting for all TCP and UDP ports to be open
  Caused by: Unsuccessful ports check for IP '172.16.0.19' and port spec '{privatePortSpec:0xc000ab6840}', even after '240' retries with '500' milliseconds in between retries. Timeout '2m0s' has been reached
  Caused by: An error occurred while calling network address '172.16.0.19:8080' with port protocol 'TCP' and using time out '200ms'
  Caused by: dial tcp 172.16.0.19:8080: i/o timeout

Error encountered running Starlark code.
```
